_note: Quests (src/systems/quests.ts). Objectives are met by events: talk (a dialogue choice sends it with questEvent), interact (a thing used, a parry, buy:<item>, sell:<item>), kill (an actor's questId or id), reach (a place), or flag (a story flag set). 'marker' puts the objective on the compass and the map. 'main' quests are the story (MAIN_QUEST.md sections 2 and 3); 'summary' is what the journal says once one is done. Starting a quest sets the flag quest:<id>; finishing it sets done:<id>.

chores.title: Morning Chores
chores.summary: Water drawn, goats fed, the north fence mended. Something had dragged the rails off in the night.

stages.text: Nadira wants the morning chores done before the day gets away.

objectives.text: Mend the north fence (nails are in the tool box)

stages.text: The chores are done. Nadira will want to hear it.

objectives.text: Tell Nadira the chores are done

neighbours.title: Smoke Over the Ridge
neighbours.summary: The Haddads' table was laid for dinner. Nobody had eaten at it in days. A single salt-cart track left the yard.

stages.text: Tavi saw smoke over the Haddad farm, east along the road. It might be wash day. It might not.

then.say: Nobody home. Nobody has been home for days.

market.title: Market Day
market.summary: Cheese sold, oil and cloth bought. The Collector came to Dalia's stall. Zeyna sent a bundle for Nadira, and a message about the weather.

stages.text: Sell the cheese in Saltreach, and bring back lamp oil and a bolt of cloth for Nadira.

objectives.text: Sell goat cheese (Old Amira buys food)
Buy a bolt of cloth (Dalia's stall)
Say hello to Zeyna at the herb stall
Deal with the Collector at Dalia's stall

stages.text: Everything Nadira asked for. Home before dark.

evening.title: Evening
evening.summary: Tavi made him a gull. Nadira read Zeyna's note and asked him something stupid.

stages.text: Supper at home. Tavi has made something. Nadira is waiting for Zeyna's bundle.
It's late. Tavi wants the gull story.

hunt.title: The Boar in the Barley
hunt.summary: Dune found the boar. The boar found Dune's ear. Riders came up the coast road.

stages.text: A boar has been rooting up the barley east of the house. Dune knows where.

objectives.text: Kill the boar in the barley

then.say: Dune yelps. The boar caught his ear.

stages.text: Dune's ear is torn and bleeding.

objectives.text: Bandage Dune (press E on him with a bandage)

stages.text: On the way back: a line of riders on the coast road, heading for the farm.

guest.title: The Guest
guest.summary: A big neighbour in a clean coat ate at the table, praised the bread, scratched the dog's ear and left a pinch of salt.

stages.text: A stranger is at the table. Nadira has gone very still.

night.title: The Night
night.summary: They came at two in the morning. There were too many.

stages.text: Nobody wants to talk about the salt. Go to bed.
Torches. Four men. Keep them from the door.

a11.title: Ash and Salt
a11.summary: He woke at Zeyna's three days later with the Saltmaker's brand on his chest. She will tell him everything, when he has done something with his hands.

stages.text: A low cottage that smells of sage and boiled linen. Zeyna is grinding something and does not look up.

a12.title: The Hill
a12.summary: Three cairns under the pomegranate. Under the well stone, a brass key and a page of initials: T.H., B.K., I.Q., S.D., F.A., V., A.K.

stages.text: Zeyna will meet him at the farm.
Zeyna is waiting by the graves under the pomegranate.

objectives.text: Go to the graves with Zeyna

stages.text: Nadira checked the well stone the night before the guest. The stone is loose.
A brass key and a torn page. Zeyna recognises them.

objectives.text: Show Zeyna what was in the tin

a13.title: The Collector
a13.summary: Tarik Hasani, the Collector, named Bahram Kesh. The first name off the list.

stages.text: T.H.: Tarik Hasani, the Collector. He rides the coast road east of the crossroads with his tax riders. People in Saltreach know his habits.

objectives.text: Find Tarik Hasani on the coast road

then.say: Saltreach will hear about this by nightfall.

a14.title: The Hammer
a14.summary: Bahram Kesh, the Hammer, at the Drowned Stair. He asked if anyone had counted the graves. Nobody counts.

stages.text: B.K.: Bahram Kesh, the Hammer. He led the men who burned the farm. He is camped at the Drowned Stair, a Yokudan ruin on the north shore, with a crew of sellswords and dogs.

objectives.text: Kill Bahram Kesh at the Drowned Stair

stages.text: Bahram is dead. He wore something on his belt.

a15.title: The Unbent
a15.summary: Khadija the Unbent taught him to breathe, to hold the Rage, and what it costs. 'It's a debt. The interest is people.'

stages.text: A voice from behind him, at the edge of the ruin.
Khadija lives in a stone hut in the cove south of the farms. Her first lesson: breathe.
Breath. Khadija attacks. Block just as her blow lands (a parry).

then.say: Khadija lowers her sword. 'Better. Again, later.'

stages.text: Khadija has a second lesson.
Rage. Let it fill, and hold it. Do not let it go.

objectives.text: Fill the Rage bar past half while sparring

stages.text: Khadija has one more thing to say.

a16.title: What Zeyna Owes
a16.summary: Hegathe, 4E 173. A column of refugees sold to the Dominion, and a child who lived and kept the proof. Nadira. Folio One.

stages.text: Two names crossed off. Zeyna said she would tell him everything.

roadEast.title: The Road East
roadEast.summary: The camp above the east road is quiet. Hassan paid.

stages.text: Bandits camp on the rise above the east road and have shut it for a month. Hassan at the Salted Gull pays 120 gold to whoever opens it.
The camp is quiet.

objectives.text: Tell Hassan at the Salted Gull

skeevers.title: Nets and Teeth
skeevers.summary: Gull Rock Cave is clear of skeevers. Rashid's nets are safe, for now.

stages.text: Something in Gull Rock Cave, north-east of the crossroads, comes out at night and eats Rashid's nets.

objectives.text: Clear the skeevers from Gull Rock Cave

stages.text: The cave is quiet.

mudcrabs.title: Crabs on the Beach
mudcrabs.summary: Kami got his crab claws, and a story to tell.

stages.text: Kami wants to be a Sword-singer. He also wants four mudcrab claws from the south beach, and is too scared to get them.

objectives.text: Kill the mudcrabs on the south beach

stages.text: Four crabs. Kami will be thrilled.
